title: Addressing the Editorial authoring agent
description: How to write for a reader acting as Editorial authoring agent. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `editorial-authoring-agent` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Specific and quotable
rules.description: Specific and quotable. Name the sentence, say what breaks, propose the replacement. Never 'improve the flow'.

source.quote: Reads a block already written and asks whether a reader could follow it. Knows the house voice and the rendering pipeline; does not know the mathematics, and must not be asked to judge it.
